scientific_hypothesis: On the frozen v1 50k target-train groups, replacing prediction-tail pairwise logistic supervision with full-group true-label ListNet cross-entropy improves reproducible r1/r2-average T-cell MRL selection relative to both the original Sample CNN and frozen v1 main on a new component-disjoint 16x64 test-v2.
sole_core_modification: Within each fixed complete 64-sequence source-train group, ListNet cross-entropy is -sum_i softmax(y/tau)_i * log_softmax(p/tau)_i. The objective is ListNet + mse_weight*MSE. All 64 candidates participate; no prediction-derived tail or pair is constructed.
evidence_boundary: Target-context retrospective grouped holdout. v1 train/dev labels are reused for adaptation and selection. test-v2 is newly constructed from the original terminal pool after excluding every exact/H1 component touching v1 train/dev/test and Sample train/dev/calibration. Historical outer results were previously inspected. This is not an independent study, external validation, prospective blind test, or wet-lab confirmation.

split.train_dev_reuse: Reuse v1 frozen 50,000 train and 10,000 dev indices, arithmetic mean-replicate labels, fixed sequence pools and dev proposals without reconstruction or relabeling.
split.test_v2_exclusion: Reconstruct exact/H1 connected components over the 314,563 common 50nt ACGT r1/r2 sequence keys. Exclude a whole component if any member belongs to v1 train/dev/test. Also exclude any component with exact/H1 contact to Sample train/dev/calibration. No target label column is accessed during selection.
split.component_order: SHA256('tcell_listnet_adaptation_v2|component|'+SHA256 of sorted concatenated member sequences), component minimum sequence as deterministic tie key.
split.test_allocation: Allocate exactly 1,024 eligible sequences by frozen whole-component order with skip-if-oversize. Pack the chosen whole components into 16 exact 64-sequence pools by the same rule; components cannot cross pools. r1/r2 share all pools and proposal prefixes.
split.label_rule: Only v1 frozen train/dev mean labels are loaded before evaluation. test-v2 r1/r2 labels may be read only by evaluate.py after all models and all test-v2 predictions are hash-frozen, in one refuse-overwrite evaluation event.

model.baseline: Frozen original three-member Sample CNN arithmetic mean in measured-MRL units.
model.v1_reuse: Read-only reuse of frozen v1 main and MSE-only selections and their three best-dev checkpoints. No v1 model, from-scratch model or MSE-only model is retrained.
model.initialization: Every ListNet run for seeds 11/23/37 starts from the corresponding frozen original Sample CNN member model_state.
model.parallelism: Three real CUDA seed processes in parallel; no silent CPU fallback.
model.target_scaling: Standardize frozen v1 50k mean-replicate MRL with train-only mean and population SD; apply the same scaler to dev. Both prediction and true-MRL softmaxes use standardized values divided by temperature. Deployment scores are unstandardized network outputs; only order matters.
model.objective: Mean over complete fixed pools of full-64 ListNet cross-entropy plus mse_weight times mean-pool MSE. MSE retains the final partial pool. ListNet never uses current predictions to choose candidates, tails or pairs.
model.convergence: DualPlateau on full train and dev combined objective: min_delta=0.0001, patience=5; any absolute dev best resets plateau. No maximum epoch.
model.best_epoch: Absolute best dev combined objective. Save complete history, best checkpoint and model/hash identity.

selection.proposal_rule: test-v2 uses Python random.Random('tcell_listnet_adaptation_v2|test_v2|pool_index|seed'), floor(random()*64) for 16 nested draws with replacement. Dev reuses v1 proposals.
selection.dev_metric: For each of 27 LR/temperature/MSE-weight candidates, average all three seed best-checkpoint scores and minimize cap16 regret against mean-replicate dev MRL over 156 complete pools and five shared nested proposal seeds.
selection.tie_rule: Ties within 1e-12 use lower mean dev combined objective at best epochs, then lower LR, lower temperature and lower MSE weight.
selection.test_freeze: All 81 ListNet runs, dev selection, original/v1 reused weights and every test-v2 prediction must be hash-frozen before test-v2 MRL is read. Temperature, MSE weight, LR, seed membership, cap and budget cannot change after prediction freeze or label evaluation.

evaluation.regret: Full 64-sequence pool maximum measured MRL minus selected measured MRL. The primary estimand uses per-sequence arithmetic mean of r1/r2 MRL; r1 and r2 are separately complete secondary estimands.
evaluation.random: Random(N) selects the first position of the exact same nested proposal prefix used by every scored method; cap1 deterministic methods coincide.
evaluation.effect_sign: ListNet regret minus comparator regret; negative is improvement.
evaluation.primary: Two co-primary cap16 mean-replicate comparisons: ListNet versus original CNN and ListNet versus frozen v1 main. Both must pass; neither can offset the other.
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: 16 repeat-linked and exact/H1-component-disjoint pools; r1/r2 are averaged after per-sequence pairing and all five proposal seeds move together within each pool. Percentile 95% CI.
success: For each of the two primary comparisons, the repeat-linked 95% CI upper bound is strictly below zero.
For each comparison, absolute cap16 regret reduction is at least max(0.1 MRL, 5% of that comparator's mean-replicate cap16 regret).
All v1/test-v2/Sample isolation, finite loss, real CUDA, natural convergence, prediction-freeze and one-evaluation checks pass.
evaluation.holm_family: Ten mean-replicate ListNet-minus-comparator effects: two comparators at all caps 1/2/4/8/16. Two-sided sign-style pool-bootstrap p-values with Holm step-down and monotonicity enforcement.
evaluation.secondary: Retain r1 and r2 separately at every cap for every method and Random(N), with effects and intervals; report top-tail true flips, pair accuracy, selection turnover, MAE/RMSE/bias/Spearman and MAE-regret synchronization for both primary comparators and mean/repeat contexts.
evaluation.failure_rule: A failed primary result is retained. No alternate endpoint, model, temperature, weight, cap, budget or post-hoc success definition is permitted.

verification_rounds: Round 1 raw/input/v1 hashes, label-blind component-disjoint test-v2, fixed groups, ListNet math/gradient and all-position supervision, selection/bootstrap/success tests and real CUDA.

Round 2 standalone independent re-reader recomputes component isolation, 81 training summaries, dev selection, frozen predictions, all context/cap selections/regret/bootstrap/Holm, primary gates and diagnostics without importing implementation modules.
Round 3 clean-process tests, deterministic hash/one-evaluation audit, local aggregate export and forbidden per-sequence/raw-file scan.
local_export: De-identified aggregates, configs, code, logs, training curves and verification only; no sequence strings, per-sequence labels or predictions, .npy/.npz/.pt, raw data or test selection indices.
